purpose: Define MCP as an explicit registry of configured external tool/resource servers and their declared surfaces, separate from the runtime Tool Registry and from transport/session state.

topics.name: MCP Registry
topics.purpose: Define MCP as an explicit registry of configured external tool/resource servers and their declared surfaces, separate from the runtime Tool Registry and from transport/session state.

semantics.registry_rule: MCP registry contains explicit configured MCP server identities and metadata.
semantics.identity_rule: MCP server identity is canonical/logical identity, not socket/session/process id.
semantics.tool_rule: Advertised MCP tools may be projected into Runtime Tool Registry only after explicit validation/binding.
semantics.resource_rule: Advertised MCP resources remain external resource descriptors until explicitly bound.
semantics.connectivity_rule: Connected/discovered state does not grant capability or authority.
semantics.config_rule: Registry configuration is declarative and inert until normal connect/load lifecycle.

invariants.rule: MCP server identity, transport, tool schema, lifecycle and authority remain explicit and do not inherit trust from connectivity or advertised metadata.

hard_gates.condition: MCP connection automatically creates trusted runtime tool
server session id used as semantic MCP identity
MCP registry conflated with Runtime Tool Registry

references.purpose: Validated MCP tools may bind into runtime tool registry.
MCP servers/resources are explicit external boundaries.
